title: The Crew
author: Olaf Nowacki
description:
The Crew – Journey to the Pale Planet
What could be sweeter than going on an adventure with friends?

The Crew is a very short interactive sci-fi horror story with hardly any puzzles.

Age recommendation
Possibly PG-13. This game is meant to be scary and gross. If you don't feel like being creeped or grossed out, don't play it. And especially don't complain that it wasn't scary enough!
Other than that, there's no swearing, no nudity, drinking or drugging.
